sources.excerpt: Nervos-Community-Catalyst/CKBuilder-projects ckb-cycle-tools: per-script cycle profiling, flamegraphs and PR cycle reports for CKB Scripts OPEN ## Project Summary Tools to answer two questions about a CKB Script: how many cycles it uses on the transactions it will really see (failure paths included), and where inside the script they go. `ckb-cycles` rebuilds any committed transaction (or one not yet on chain) as a ckb-debugger mock, runs each script group once, and checks that the groups add up to exactly what the node reported. The same replay runs in the browser through ckb-debugger's WebAssembly build. On top of that: flamegraphs per script, a GitHub Action that posts a cycle diff on every pull request, and a like-for-like benchmark of the same lock written in Rust and for ckb-js-vm. ## Tools used - TypeScript, `@ckb-ccc/core`, CKB JSON-RPC - `ckb-debugger` (native 1.1.1 for the CLI, the 0.200.1 WebAssembly build shipped in `ckb-testtool` for the browser) - `ckb-testtool`, `ckb-js-vm`, `@ckb-js-std/core` for the benchmark - Next.js on Vercel for the web inspector, Vitest, GitHub Actions (a composite Action for the PR report) ## Current features - `ckb-cycles `: per-script-group cycles, with the sum checked against the node. Matches exactly on the testnet transactions in the README, including a Type ID deployment, a ckb-js-vm counter update and a Nervos DAO withdrawal (input headers are replayed). Older transactions replay on the CKB-VM version of their block, taken from the node's hardfork epochs. - Failure path: `--file` profiles a transaction that is not on chain and shows which script refuses it, its exit code and its cost. CI replays a real session-lock spend edited to overspend by one shannon and requires the lock's code 12. - Clear exit codes: 0 accepted and matching, 1 a script rejects or the sum differs, 2 environment error (so a test cannot pass because the node was down). - `ckb-cycles flame`: flamegraph per script group (SVG and folded stacks), with the costliest functions printed. `--bin` takes an unstripped build and checks it costs exactly the deployed binary's cycles. Example in the README: a real subscription charge of the session lock, 20,999 cycles, where reading lock hashes is the largest cost. - PR cycle reports: `ckb-cycles report`, `diff` and `mock`, and a composite GitHub Action (`action/`) that replays the scenarios in a `cycles.json` for the PR and its base and keeps one sticky comment with the per-group diff, any accept/reject

Nervos-Community-Catalyst/CKBuilder-projects ckb-devnet-explorer: a block explorer for local OffCKB devnets that names your own scripts OPEN ## Project Summary When you build on CKB, most of your time is spent on a local devnet started by `offckb node`, and the official CKB Explorer can't see that chain. ckb-devnet-explorer is a block explorer for it. It is one Node process that reads the devnet node directly (JSON-RPC plus the node's built-in indexer), with no database to set up, and it starts with one command inside a project deployed with `offckb deploy`. It follows the official CKB Explorer's design system and covers the official explorer's pages that make sense on a devnet. On top of that it adds what you need while building: your own scripts named from `deployment/scripts.json`, every cell's contents decoded, the node's reason when a transaction is rejected, a faucet, and an automatic rebuild after `offckb clean`. It is my CKBuilders capstone, and RetricSu is integrating it into offckb as its first local plugin ([ckb-devrel/offckb#542](https://github.com/ckb-devrel/offckb/pull/542)). ## Tools used - TypeScript run by `tsx`, Node 22, no build step - `@ckb-ccc/core` (addresses, hashing, molecule) and `@ckb-ccc/spore` (spore and cluster data) - CKB JSON-RPC and the node's built-in indexer (`get_cells`, `get_transactions`, `get_cells_capacity`), batched - OffCKB: `offckb system-scripts`, each project's `deployment/scripts.json`, `offckb transfer` for the faucet - Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript modules in the browser, with the official [CKB Explorer frontend](https://github.com/nervosnetwork/ckb-explorer-frontend)'s design system (MIT) ## Current features - **Your scripts by name.** Genesis scripts come from `offckb system-scripts`, yours from `deployment/scripts.json` (several projects at once with `--project`). JS contracts behind `ckb-js-vm` are named as the contract, by reading the code hash out of the args. - **Code cells recognised** per RFC 0022, by data hash and by type hash, so both your deployments and the genesis cells are labelled. A "Your scripts" check flags a deployment whose code cell isn't on the chain any more (what happens after `offckb clean`). - **Every cell decoded:** contract code, sUDT and xUDT amounts, spores (text, JSON and images) and clusters, Nervos DAO deposits and withdrawals, Type ID, plain text.
